description: This file defines the class NoopCborFactory, which implements the CborFactory interface with methods that all throw UnsupportedOperationException, indicating it does not support actual CBOR capabilities. It serves as a no-operation (noop) placeholder implementation.

classes.name: NoopCborFactory
classes.description: A no-operation implementation of the CborFactory interface that throws UnsupportedOperationException for all methods, indicating no actual CBOR functionality.

methods.name: isCborAvailable
methods.description: Returns false indicating CBOR is not available in this implementation.

methods.name: readFrom
methods.description: Throws UnsupportedOperationException for all overloads, indicating reading CBOR data is unsupported.

methods.name: toByteArray
methods.description: Throws UnsupportedOperationException; does not convert JsonValue to byte array.

methods.name: toByteBuffer
methods.description: Throws UnsupportedOperationException; does not convert JsonValue to ByteBuffer.

methods.name: writeToByteBuffer
methods.description: Throws UnsupportedOperationException; does not write JsonValue to ByteBuffer.

methods.name: createCborRepresentation
methods.description: Throws UnsupportedOperationException for both overloads; does not create CBOR representations.
